Title: Green Stripe Print Hand Block-Printed Kids Backpack
Body (HTML):
Crisp green stripes turn this backpack into the one accessory a kid actually wants to grab on the way out the door.

Block-printed on green candy-stripe cotton with a teal-green tassel zip-pull, hand-quilted with a soft cotton fill for everyday cushioning.

Right-sized for preschool, playdates, or travel, it holds a snack box, water bottle, and favourite toy with room to spare — a secure zip closure and front pocket keep small essentials within easy reach.

Hand block-printed in Jaipur, one motif pressed at a time — small variations in the print are the mark of genuine handwork, not a flaw. Dyed with azo-free, skin-safe colours.

H30 x W25 x D10cm (H12 x L10 x B4in). Suits preschool to early school years (roughly 2–6), and bigger kids too.
